mapping.draft_py:
keywords = [
    KeywordAbility(keyword=Keyword.FLYING),
]
abilities = [
    # [0] , [1]: MAPPER_GUIDE R_TWOEVENTS, "enters or attacks": the compiler's "When this creature enters"
    TriggeredAbility(
        event=ZoneChangeEvent(
            from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
            to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
            subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
        ),
        condition=None,
        effect=Seq(
            steps=(
                A(Verb.DRAW, {'amount': QConst(value=1), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
                A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
                    'cards': Selector(
                        count=QConst(value=1),
                        mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                        filter=FAnd(children=()),
                        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
                    ),
                    'controller': ControllerRef.YOU,
                    'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
                    'from': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
                }),
            ),
        ),
    ),
    # [1]
    TriggeredAbility(
        event=DeclareAttackersEvent(filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
        condition=None,
        effect=Seq(
            steps=(
                A(Verb.DRAW, {'amount': QConst(value=1), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
                A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
                    'cards': Selector(
                        count=QConst(value=1),
                        mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                        filter=FAnd(children=()),
                        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
                    ),
                    'controller': ControllerRef.YOU,
                    'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
                    'from': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
                }),
            ),
        ),
    ),
    # [2] : M21 Thieves' Guild Enforcer's verified self static (+N/+N and deathtouch, the "as long as" in
    StaticAbility(
        effect=Seq(
            steps=(
                A(Verb.MODIFY_PT, {
                    'power': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=1)),
                    'target': Selector(
                        count=QConst(value=1),
                        mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                        filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
                        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                    ),
                    'toughness': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=1)),
                }),
                A(Verb.GRANT_ABILITY, {
                    'ability': KeywordAbility(keyword=Keyword.DEATHTOUCH),
                    'target': Selector(
                        count=QConst(value=1),
                        mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                        filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
                        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                    ),
                }),
            ),
        ),
        condition=FAtom(
            pred=FAtomPred.QTY_GE,
            count=QConst(value=7),
            quantity=QCount(
                selector=Selector(
                    count=QUnbounded(),
                    mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
                    filter=FAnd(children=()),
                    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
                ),
            ),
        ),
    ),
    # [3]
    SpellAbility(kind=SpellKind.CREATURE),
]

clauses.clause: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, draw a card, then discard a card.
Threshold — This creature gets +1/+1 and has deathtouch as long as there are seven or more cards in your graveyard.

mapping.notes: MAPPER_GUIDE R_TWOEVENTS 'enters or attacks': the enters trigger and DeclareAttackersEvent(IS_SOURCE), byte-equal effects, Obsessive Stitcher's verified loot; Threshold as Thieves' Guild Enforcer's verified self static (+1/+1 and deathtouch, StaticAbility.condition at_least(7, quantity=number_in(...)) over your graveyard). packs in tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/: dreadwing_scavenger_threshold_seven_cards, dreadwing_scavenger_six_cards_no_threshold. Ontology round R12: the tree translated into the one comparison (same meaning), the draft, clauses and notes reworded.
